title: Single Cell Browser
bodyHtml:
Explore interactive visualizations of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) from human and mouse adipose tissue. Within a selected dataset, visualize interactive plots of cell type clusters, gene expression, cell type abundance, and marker gene expression. Query a gene name and filter results using the desired parameters. Please be patient, as data may take time to load. 

Explore MATKP to learn more about adipose tissue-relevant datasets, phenotypes, gene information, or differential gene expression in various conditions. Contribute to the growing body of adipose-related knowledge by submitting your data to the MATKP here.

If you use data from this page, please review our Citation Policies to ensure proper citation of the underlying resource(s) used to generate these maps.
